body:
After we got a lot of user feedback on the prototype of our patch in 2024, we turned our attention to what the underlying consequences of today's health problems look like, and what thread everyone we know shared in common.

Our first run showed us that people are more desperate than ever for freedom and agency — in the sense that we don't want to feel like the machines. Constantly measured, reinforced, and forecasted. Our imperfection is what makes us human, and in the spirit of the founders' dualistic philosophy, what defines us.

The true value we want to deliver: to help people feel like themselves again.
— Identity (2026)

Health should be effortless. The ability to live freely while staying healthy shouldn't be an afterthought — it should be the path of least resistance.

Preventative health over recovery. Treating a problem after it's already happened is the laziest version of care. Our entire philosophy starts one step earlier: before anything goes wrong.

Our authority is science. We don't make claims we can't back up. If the evidence doesn't support it, it doesn't go on the label.

Simplicity requires depth. It's easy to make something complicated. It's hard to make something that works and feels simple. Word salad is not a substitute for clarity.
— Identity (2026), "What We Believe"

Most people aren't pragmatic — they want to feel something.
— Vi, 2026-02-24

Latin aqua vitae means alcohol, essence of life — water of life.
— Vi, 2024-09-20
